title: The most insane London theatre two show day and I WOULDN’T HAVE IT AN...
transcript: What is the most diabolically unhinged two show day one can have in London right now? Honestly, stellar two show day. We have Theatre of kindness followed by Theatre of cruelty. Both fantastic productions in their own right. And yet I think what makes both of them so successful is not just incredible performances, design, direction, all that, but the fact that within all of the kindness of Paddington, there is still cruelty. There is still the cruelty found in the world. And within all of the cruelty in cleansed, there's still kindness, there's still love, there's still hope. I think seeing what is similar about these two vastly, vastly different productions makes one really realise what works in theatre and what doesn't. Anyway, I would recommend this two show day to you, but cleansed is completely sold out and closes this weekend, so there you go. But as far as tickets go, I was able to get tickets to both of these shows last minute yesterday, right before I went to go see them. Just keep checking. Sold out doesn't necessarily mean that you can't get in.
